narr: Hurricane Henri moved up the U.S. Atlantic coast and over parts of southeast New York on August 22 to 23, 2021. Bands of heavy rainfall moved across parts of northeast Pennsylvania producing significant flash flooding in some locations.
ev: Severe flash flooding occurred on Main Street. Two vehicles were seen floating away across from the CVS Pharmacy.
A vehicle was stuck in floodwaters on Main Street across from Planet Fitness.
Floodwaters surrounded two vehicles on Commerce Boulevard across from Taco Bell.
A vehicle was stuck in floodwaters on South Apple Street.
Flooding occurred on Advent Road between Lake Ariel Highway and Golf Park Drive. All lanes were shut down in both directions. Washouts possible.
Numerous city streets flooded. Multiple vehicles partially submerged and stranded in the city.
Flooding occurred on Pond Road in both directions between Hollister Road and Twin Rocks Road. All lanes closed with washouts.
Street flooding and washouts were observed. Rainfall reported from this area was 3.57 inches in a short amount of time.

Flooding occurred throughout Pittston. Especially hard hit were areas along Main Street in both directions between James A Musto ballpark and Tedrick Street. All lanes were closed and cars were stranded.
PA Route 92 was flooded in both directions between Tunkhannock Avenue and the river. All lanes were closed with stranded vehicles.
There was road and street flooding due to overwhelmed storm drain systems throughout Hughestown.
